No account · Works offline · Your data stays on your phone
Birth details, family profiles and saved places are stored only on this device, in encrypted form.
Calculations run on your phone. The app does not need an internet connection.
Nothing leaves your phone unless you choose to share a card or a Bond Code. A Bond Code carries only derived traits, never birth details.
Location is used only if you ask for it, once, to find your nearest city. The coordinates are not saved.
Names, birth details and places are never written to logs or analytics.
